en.headline: Hong Kong and Shenzhen customs meet on new Huanggang port operations
en.dek: Acting Commissioner Woo Wai-kwan inspected joint one-stop vehicle lanes after talks with Huanggang Customs on passenger and cargo checks and emergency coordination.
body: Hong Kong Customs’ acting commissioner, Woo Wai-kwan, held a working meeting on Wednesday with Huanggang Customs commissioner Shi Hongtu to discuss how the rebuilt Huanggang control point will run once it opens.

Customs said the two sides talked through day-to-day cooperation after opening, including coordination among passenger and vehicle inspection units and an arrangement for sharing information quickly if an incident occurs, so clearance can keep moving.

Woo also inspected tests on the joint one-stop vehicle lanes and spoke with staff on site. The department said the tests were proceeding in an orderly way and that it would keep working with other agencies to open the port as soon as both sides judge operations to be safe and smooth. No opening date was announced.

zh.headline: 港深海關開會部署新皇崗口岸運作
zh.dek: 署理關長胡偉軍周三與皇崗海關關長施宏圖開會，並視察聯合一站式車道測試，雙方未公布開通日期。
body: 香港海關署理關長胡偉軍周三與皇崗海關關長施宏圖舉行工作會議，討論新皇崗口岸開通後的日常運作及雙方合作安排。
海關表示，會議涵蓋旅檢和車檢查驗單位的協調，以及突發事故時的通報機制，務求在緊急情況下仍能維持通關秩序。
胡偉軍其後到聯合一站式車道視察測試，並向現場人員了解運作。海關指測試工作有序推進，會繼續與相關部門協作，爭取口岸在雙方確認安全暢順後盡快開通，暫時未有公布日期。
